feature: BTW side-chat composer and reviewed parent export

cases.title: BTW alone mounts one ordinary composer in collapsed and expanded layouts
preconditions: root, ordinary child, and BTW child fixtures are hydrated

oracles.expected: root is unchanged, ordinary child has no ordinary composer, and BTW has exactly one composer in each layout
BTW draft remains owned by the single focused composer

negative: ordinary managed child does not gain a composer
BTW does not mount duplicate prompts
cleanup: dispose every renderer and fixture server

cases.title: repeated BTW conversation messages stay on the BTW child identity
preconditions: BTW child uses the read-only btw agent and a durable model selection

oracles.expected: both exact admissions and wakes target only the BTW child with one stable id per message
session agent and model remain btw and the original model

negative: no parent prompt, agent switch, model switch, interrupt, or generate request occurs
cleanup: dispose renderer and fixture server after request assertions

cases.title: cancelling reviewed parent export preserves the BTW draft and sends nothing
preconditions: BTW composer contains a btw-send command and the immediate parent is resident
stimulus: open an empty export preview and confirm

oracles.expected: preview names the immediate parent and the original BTW draft is restored
empty confirmation and cancellation leave the parent prompt count at zero

negative: no parent interrupt, generate, navigation, or draft clearing occurs

cases.title: confirmed reviewed export sends exact edited text as one parent steer
preconditions: review preview is addressed to the immediate parent

oracles.expected: one parent prompt carries the exact preview text, delivery steer, and a protocol message id
the route remains on BTW after success

negative: no summarization, parent interrupt, implicit navigation, or child prompt occurs

cases.title: failed reviewed export retries the immutable payload with the same id
preconditions: first parent admission returns a transport failure

oracles.expected: both attempts use the same parent, text, delivery, and message id
failure keeps an editable retry dialog available

negative: no fresh-id replay or retargeting occurs

cases.title: BTW conversation cannot replace its read-only agent profile through local selection
preconditions: local primary agent differs from the BTW child's durable agent
stimulus: submit an ordinary message from the BTW composer

oracles.expected: no session agent-switch request is sent
the BTW Session retains its read-only btw agent

negative: local primary-agent fallback does not widen BTW permissions
